sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied candidate is semantically supported for the required per-device inventory, relationship, or mandatory-device selection terms; communicationDeviceAvailability is explicitly a ship-level quantity and cannot represent universal per-device availability.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The candidate does not faithfully encode the universal requirement that every mandatory survival-craft communication device remain available for at least the maximum expected rescue time: it checks one ship-level availability value only and provides no device inventory, mandatory-device selection, or per-device availability path.
